testSet: 60 hand-labelled messages (12 po, 12 pr, 12 enquiry, 12 followup, 12 mdm) in regional English (Singlish, Malaysian, Thai/Vietnamese/Myanmar English, terse, forwarded threads), written blind before the rules were read and never used to tune them. 33 are deliberately tricky (PO numbers inside follow-ups, enquiries with quantities, MDM asks inside orders). Accuracy on tricky ones: 0.879; on plain ones: 0.963.
plain: On 60 messages written without seeing the rules, the rules put 92 of every 100 in the right stream (88 of 100 on the 33 deliberately tricky ones). A person still confirms every routing.

errors.subject: re: urine cups
errors.why: Rules saw: States quantity 50 ctn; No PO number yet — pipeline, not demand. Actually a PO: no 'PO' keyword at all ('order no ... raised in Ariba'); Singlish 'ok can, go ahead' looks like a PR acceptance.

errors.subject: Tempahan stok - microscope slides
errors.why: Rules saw: Asks about stock for; No PO number or commitment to buy. Actually a purchase request: Malay-English; 'LO' (Malaysian government local order = their PO) not yet issued.

errors.subject: Re: PO 55871 delivered - repeat order
errors.why: Rules saw: Refers to an existing order (delivery documents: "goods received"); Contains PO number PO 55871. Actually a purchase request: opens like a follow-up on an existing PO, but the actionable content is a NEW intent with qty and no PO yet.

errors.subject: RE: PO coming - but please fix our account first
errors.why: Rules saw: PO still to come ("PO coming"); States quantity 20 boxes. Actually a MDM request: 'PO' + qty in subject/body, but the blocking ask is a customer-record update (name + bill-to).

errors.subject: PO from Chao Phraya Central - Glucose reagent
errors.why: Rules saw: States quantity 24 box; No PO number yet — pipeline, not demand. Actually a PO: 'P/O' spelling; Thai Buddhist-era year 2569 in PO number.
